submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 5.5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.033% at 100 GeV, significantly outperforming both F2 (4.016% at 4 mm) and F1 (4.975% at 5 mm). This represents approximately 25% better resolution than F2 and 39% better than F1. The thickness of 5.5 mm is well within the specified 2-10 mm range and was identified through systematic optimization that included fine-grained scanning around the initial optimal point at 5 mm. This configuration best meets the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 5.5 mm achieves 3.033% resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations (overall_best_resolution = 3.033, overall_best_material = 3, overall_best_thickness_mm = 5.5)

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
requirements.evidence: No activation or dose rate data was collected during the simulation campaign (activation_data_available = 0, dose_rate_data_available = 0). This hard safety requirement cannot be verified from available results and requires additional analysis before final implementation.
Recommended thickness of 5.5 mm is within the specified range of 2-10 mm (recommended_thickness_mm = 5.5)
